title: Hollow Crown: 4 bosses, 3 classes, every death is your fault. Playable in browser. Made with opus 5.5 + godot.
author: tooavg
selftext:
[itch.io link to the game](https://vestom.itch.io/hollowcrown)



**What it is:**

\>4 bosses, each built like a puzzle: a Skeleton Warlord who chains you in, a Frost Dragon you hide from behind pillars, a Slime King who heals if you let his blobs crawl back, and an Archmage who makes whole rows of the floor fall into the void

\>3 classes: Knight (parry to earn a whirlwind), Hunter (bow + wolf), Reaper (every third hit reaps)

\>Every attack is telegraphed: if you die, it should feel like *your* mistake

\>Roguelite runs: a minion room before each boss teaches its mechanic, then you pick upgrade cards that change the rules

One run takes about 15–25 minutes.

I’d really love feedback: which boss killed you the most, and did it feel fair? Also, if it runs badly on your machine, tell me your browser + GPU (there’s a quality setting in Options and F3 shows fps).
